study: Try to understand, don't memorize. If you get the why, you can rebuild the how.
Information takes time to sink in. Take breaks and come back to it.
Explain what you just learned out loud, as if teaching a friend. Gaps show up fast.
Short sessions every day beat one long session the night before.
coding: Document your work in comments. Future you will thank you.
Read the error message slowly and fully before changing anything.
Write a small piece, run it, then write the next piece. Don't write 200 lines before testing.
Name things clearly. A good variable name saves you a comment.
